name: Realvia Real Estate
author: Webex Digital

sections.description:
The plugin is used for exporting and displaying real estate listings from Realvia to your website.

Functions

‘realvia_get_real_estates’
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. A menu item called \”Realvia settings\” will appear. Copy the authorization key from there.
  3. Go to your \”Realvia\” website admin panel. Navigate to Export -> Multi Export. Paste the copied key into the \”identifikator 1\” field. Name it accordingly.
  4. On the real estate page, find the \”Export\” section and click Send where the name from step 3 is listed.
  5. If successful, you will see a green notification window. If you see an orange window for any reason, check the FAQ section for troubleshooting.
  6. In your WordPress site, you can use a ready-made function to retrieve the data sent to you by \”Realvia\”.
sections.faq:
If you encounter errors from Realvia, please check the following solutions:

1) Verify the Realvia export settings.
2) Check Settings -> Permalinks -> Permalink Structure, and ensure it is set to Day and name. If it is not, update it accordingly.
